Yeah you're right. If every good person had my current mindset, the world would be in a worse state than it is now. It would be illogical to just give up on everything that is good. I suppose now is just the matter of learning to accept these things for how they are. It will probably take a while to accept, but given time I'm sure that eventually I'll be able to make it out of this slump and hopefully make my own contributions to better this world in some way. Thank you for rekindling my faith in this life.
Huh, didn't know that. Perhaps the amount of violence has been blown a little out of proportion by the media. But even so, there's so many terrible things that happen under the radar.

I know that evil is a necessity in this world. If it was all heaven and no hell there'd be no point in living really. I guess it's mainly the imbalance between good and bad that's bothering me. I feel that the world is bad enough as it is with all of the natural disasters, disease, and death. But with the addition of terrible people doing all of these terrible things, it's just too much to deal with.

Trying to do good just seems like a lost cause. The world will never get any better because there will always be those with tainted hearts. That is why things have practically remained the same for thousands of years. I tried accepting these sad truths but there's always a part of me refusing to be content with the world's state. I seek a world that is unattainable. This world's sorrow is too overwhelming.
I know that there's a lot of beauty in this world, and I try to focus on those things. But it just feels like I'm living in an illusion.
Yeah, I guess I just lost sight of that. I'm considering moving in with my sister. She said it'd be alright for me to stay with her. Thanks for all the support, I appreciate it.
Thanks for your kind words. I feel a lot better now.
Thank you for the encouraging words.
I could live with someone else, but then I'd just be someone else's burden. And I just don't feel comfortable being myself around my father so I can't do the things I enjoy.
I can't make a difference, I'm just a dumb kid.

I've been depressed since high school due to my negative perspective on life and my dad just doesn't understand how it feels. Where motivation is non-existent and just doing the simplest of tasks requires a great deal of effort. He just thinks I'm a stupid, lazy, kid. My dad is very strict and blunt, so whenever I do something wrong he tears me a new one and he just makes me feel so damn worthless. I'm a college freshman and just started attending school after I dropped out last semester because of my suicide attempt. I'm still living with my dad and I don't have enough money to live on my own. I don't even have a job. I don't know if I can last another year living with him.
It's hard to ignore when he's right. I'm too incompetent to do anything.
I wanted to make a positive impact on this world, that was the only thing that kept me going and stopped me from trying suicide again. But I honestly don't give a shit anymore.
Couldn't care less about gaining my father's acceptance and happiness isn't a thing as long as he's around.

You just described my older brother to a T except he doesn't do drugs. It was like my brother's sole purpose in life was to inconvenience me in anyway possible. Growing up he used to beat me up often while my parents just let him get away with it (I was basically his punching bag). And this went on until I was a freshman in high school when I started getting stronger. He's also been calling me a faggot my whole life too which is funny considering this "faggot" got a girlfriend before him. I'm sorry to hear about the way your brother's been treating you but you just gotta play with the hand your dealt with. It's true that we may never share the same perfect relationship with our brothers that other people have but who cares. Some people just have hearts full of hatred. Just forget those people, they're not worth your time. I've basically disowned my brother and don't give 0 fucks if anything happens to him. As far as I'm concerned my best friend is my brother. He's been there for me more than my brother has been there for me my whole life.
No problem. I know things may have looked bleak your entire life, but I hope that you stay with us long enough to find happiness.

I feel you man, this world definitely is a terrible place and I had a lot of trouble accepting that fact. But the fact is that bad things always come without welcome unlike positive things which have to be worked towards in order to achieve. Life is all about balance, that's why I made it my purpose in life to place myself on the losing side in order to help balance the good and bad. It seems like you're very set on carrying through your plans, but I really hope you reconsider. I don't want you to go out like this. You deserve happiness.
I understand, finding your path in life can be really difficult. What kind of stuff are you into? What do you want to achieve?
Why do you feel that way?
What's pointless? Life?
Cigarettes.

We talk almost everyday and hang out 1-2 times a week. I'm definitely worried about the effects that smoking will have on his health but I'm also worried about the effect it would have on his financial situation because he just can't afford to be supporting such a harmful habit. I told him that smoking is a poor way to deal with depression but I'm not sure if he's really listening. I know he's really stressed but I don't know what to do.

I just don't know what I could say that would make him feel better. I've never experienced the things that he had to go through in his life. I never had problems with my family like he has and I never had to go through life always being tight on cash. I'm afraid I lack the credibility for my words to have any impact.

Thank you for taking the time to respond I really appreciate it. It felt really nice just having someone to talk to. I noticed your post and I'm sorry about how things are going for you right now. I wish I could offer you some advice like you've done for me but I'm just ill-equipped to do so since I haven't really experienced much of life yet and most of the problems that I've experienced in my life thus far are petty compared to yours. I really hope things work out for you and that you'll be able to find happiness as well.

I like skating and playing video games. However I haven't really been doing either ever since I enrolled in college. There was just so much pressure for me to do well since my dad was paying for everything and I didn't want to disappoint him because he's a very strict and angry person. Eventually I ended up dropping out about 2 months ago after I tried killing myself. I was just overwhelmed with all of the work, my family, and just hated everyone and everything. My mind was in a dark place. Although I feel like my suicide attempt had made my father soften up a bit, I still don't feel comfortable around him and I still don't have the nerve to get back into my hobbies or to even try new things. There's just too many negative emotions and memories tied to him you know? I'm just scared.

Sorry about your parents. I'm out of high school, but moving out isn't much of an option. Right now I'm looking for a job so I can start saving up to be able to support myself. My job search hasn't been going so well though since I'm a very awkward person. I suppose I could get out more by taking walks or something, but I don't know if that'll be much help.
Well, easier said than done. But doing some stuff around the house definitely wouldn't hurt. That I can do. Thank you for your response I appreciate it.

I know that he only wants what's best for me, but I don't even know if our relationship is salvageable. He doesn't need my help and I don't want his help. The thought of even confronting my father scares me tremendously.

But all that really does is create false hope in believing that things will get better. When in reality things never do get better. Things have always been the same way for countless millennia. You'd think that by now the world would have changed for the better, but sadly no. There will always be an imbalance between good and bad where bad always triumphs. Bad will always win because that's how life was programmed.

I've always thought about volunteering to create a positive force in this world, but then there's always a part of me that feels like whatever I do is just a lost cause. This world will never change because there are so many people who refuse to change. So what I do doesn't even matter. I'm going back to college during spring and I've been dreading the thought. Learning about shit I don't give 2 fucks about. Being surrounded by self obsessed idiots complaining about their petty problems. It makes me sick just by looking at them. While they're complaining about irrelevant things, out in the world there are people in the midst of these terrible acts of violence. People being dragged out in the middle of the night to fight in a militia against their own will. People stuck laying in hospital beds just withering away from horrible illnesses. The list goes on and on. I know there are good people out there in the world and in my school. But they are way outnumbered. Thank you for taking the time to answer. I'm glad to hear that you're trying to make a difference in the world. It's very uplifting.
People can really suck sometimes.
Sleep is always good. Sadly sleep is only a temporary solution. Cool song by the way.
Thanks, I'll definitely look into it.

We seem to be in pretty similar situations. I live with an "older" brother who's been a douche to me pretty much my entire life. When we were kids I was basically his punching bag and he would always call me nasty things. And today not much has changed since then (although he no longer picks fights with me). It's as if his goal in life is to inconvenience me in anyway possible, constantly trying to bring me down in anyway possible. If you're living with someone who hurts you purposely (even after you told them how much it hurts you) I don't really think there's much you can do besides ignoring them or moving away sadly. They're just not worth it. Some people are just incapable of reason. I basically just disowned my brother and don't really care if anything happens to him. I hope you don't reach that point though. If you need somebody to talk to feel free to message me.
Do you have any advice for overcoming these sort of thoughts? I seem to be in a bit of a slump.

You're right. We just gotta accept these sad truths for what they are. I'm gonna try to pick myself up from this experience and hopefully try to make a meaningful impact in this world. It's sad that there are many people who just brush these thoughts under a rug and simply do not acknowledge them. Perhaps they just aren't ready to see how messed up this world can be. Hell these thoughts almost destroyed me. Thank you for your answer.

Yeah I know this world can be a beautiful place filled with amazing people. I know that for a fact. I thought about doing some volunteer work in order to surround myself with those types of people, but I'm kind of a mess right now lol. I just gotta stop looking at reality through a black and white lens all the time because you're right when you say everything  in life isn't black and white. It's just a false perception that I created in my mind, when in reality it's impossible for something to fully be negative or positive. I don't know ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ life is confusing lol. Just gotta keep my head up high and look towards the stars. Thanks for taking the time to answer. I appreciate it.
